Prebuilt Mathlib d13f23b oleans from the read-only cache are trusted as compiled artifacts for elaboration; leanchecker --fresh re-checks every declaration of the import closure of the replayed modules, Mathlib included.
decide +kernel proofs are kernel reductions of Bool-valued checkers over Nat / List with GMP-accelerated Nat literals; no native code evaluation, no Lean.ofReduceBool.
The raw-certificate-to-literal equality and the seed-to-certificate expansion are the external stdlib audit audit_binding.py, not Lean theorems.
The meaning of the roots rests on reading PC100Kernel/Target.lean (byte-identical to the accepted v = 100 module) and the Mathlib/core definitions listed in manifest.json.

def PC100.IsDesign241.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} B => (∀ X ∈ B, X.card = 4) ∧ ∀ (T : Finset V), T.card = 2 → ∃! X, X ∈ B ∧ T ⊆ X
def PC100.IsParallelClass.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} B P => P ⊆ B ∧ ∀ (y : V), ∃! X, X ∈ P ∧ y ∈ X
def PC100.IsResolution.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Finset (Finset (Finset V)) → Prop :=
fun {V} B R => (∀ P ∈ R, PC100.IsParallelClass B P) ∧ ∀ X ∈ B, ∃! P, P ∈ R ∧ X ∈ P
def PC100.blockImage.{u} : {V : Type u} → Equiv.Perm V → Finset V → Finset V :=
fun {V} σ X => Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) X
def PC100.IsResolutionAutomorphism.{u} : {V : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq V] → Finset (Finset V) → Finset (Finset (Finset V)) → Equiv.Perm V → Prop :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] B R σ =>
  Finset.image (PC100.blockImage σ) B = B ∧ ∀ P ∈ R, Finset.image (PC100.blockImage σ) P ∈ R
def PC100.IsFullCycle.{u} : {V : Type u} → [DecidableEq V] → [Fintype V] → Equiv.Perm V → Prop :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V] σ => σ.IsCycle ∧ σ.support = Finset.univ
def PC100.IsPointCyclicResolution.{u} : {V : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq V] → [Fintype V] → Finset (Finset V) → Finset (Finset (Finset V)) → Prop :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V] B R =>
  PC100.IsResolution B R ∧ ∃ σ, PC100.IsFullCycle σ ∧ PC100.IsResolutionAutomorphism B R σ
def PC100.shift : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → Equiv.Perm (Fin v) :=
fun v [NeZero v] => Equiv.addRight 1
def PC100.Target : ℕ → Prop :=
fun v => ∃ B, PC100.IsDesign241 B ∧ ∃ R, PC100.IsPointCyclicResolution B R
def PC100.TargetShift : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → Prop :=
fun v [NeZero v] =>
  PC100.IsFullCycle (PC100.shift v) ∧
    ∃ B R, PC100.IsDesign241 B ∧ PC100.IsResolution B R ∧ PC100.IsResolutionAutomorphism B R (PC100.shift v)
def PC100.TargetCounts : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → Prop :=
fun v [NeZero v] =>
  ∃ B R,
    PC100.IsDesign241 B ∧
      PC100.IsResolution B R ∧
        PC100.IsResolutionAutomorphism B R (PC100.shift v) ∧
          B.card = v * (v - 1) / 12 ∧ R.card = (v - 1) / 3 ∧ ∀ P ∈ R, P.card = v / 4
def PC100.Kernel.blk : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → PC100.Kernel.RawBlock → Finset (Fin v) :=
fun v [NeZero v] e =>
  {PC100.Kernel.pt v e.1, PC100.Kernel.pt v e.2.1, PC100.Kernel.pt v e.2.2.1, PC100.Kernel.pt v e.2.2.2}
def PC100.Kernel.classOf : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → List PC100.Kernel.RawBlock → Finset (Finset (Fin v)) :=
fun v [NeZero v] c => (List.map (PC100.Kernel.blk v) c).toFinset
@[irreducible] def PC100.Kernel.blocks : (v : ℕ) →
  [NeZero v] → List (List PC100.Kernel.RawBlock) → Finset (Finset (Fin v)) :=
fun v [NeZero v] d => (List.map (PC100.Kernel.blk v) d.flatten).toFinset
@[irreducible] def PC100.Kernel.classes : (v : ℕ) →
  [NeZero v] → List (List PC100.Kernel.RawBlock) → Finset (Finset (Finset (Fin v))) :=
fun v [NeZero v] d => (List.map (PC100.Kernel.classOf v) d).toFinset
@PC100.Kernel.sound_of_check : ∀ {v : ℕ} [inst : NeZero v] {d : List (List PC100.Kernel.RawBlock)},
  PC100.Kernel.certCheck v d = true →
